title: DAY 24/90
WEEK 4 TEST
scenes.sub: Gyroscopes to Goodman: one test tonight
scenes.voice: Day twenty four of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, eighty four days to go! Week four is done. Tonight's test shows which formulas you really own.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: No new chapter today. It is week four revision: governors and gyroscope, free and forced vibration, quantitative aptitude, and fatigue design, in one test.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Revise governors, balancing and the gyroscopic couple, damping and transmissibility, percentages and time and work, then Goodman and Soderberg. Redo every question you missed.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Natural frequency in hertz is fifteen point seven six over root of static deflection in millimetres. The same rule gives a shaft's critical speed.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Get the free practice PDF on Telegram now. Weekly test: seven to nine P. M. Take it through our Telegram channel link, or visit our website, on mobile or laptop.

scenes.title: Day 23 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day twenty three toppers! Rahul Yadav takes rank one on the fatigue design test, Atharva Vyas rank two, and Sweta Rani Sahoo rank three. Congratulations to all three!
